problem_plain: PruittHealth, a post-acute provider, experienced a ~$75M revenue decline in skilled nursing facilities due to COVID-19 labour shortages, admission restrictions and inflation-driven margin pressure.
capability: Data-centric methodology applied across three growth levers: sales effectiveness, cost optimisation, and talent acquisition and retention, including redesigned recruitment and retention programmes for RNs and CNAs.
scale_outcomes: +4.8% revenue growth and +4.0% contribution margin growth versus engagement baseline
reusable: Data-centric approach to growth optimisation across sales effectiveness, cost management and talent acquisition/retention in healthcare settings; recruitment and retention programme redesign for clinical staff.
summary: Veridane applied a data-centric methodology to help PruittHealth address revenue and margin pressures from COVID-19 impacts across three growth levers. Results included +4.8% revenue growth and +4.0% contribution margin growth, outpacing the industry.
